description: Builds a one-page summary of a single investment for family members from its SharePoint folder of tax statements, dividend statements, investor updates, annual reports and correspondence (subfolders included). AI reads each document for the investment's terms, dividends, valuations and milestones and writes a plain-English overview. The dividends are checked against the receipts in the Xero bank accounts. The result is a PDF with invested capital, carrying value, dividends, MOIC and IRR, a value-created chart, dividends by financial year, key terms, milestones and the source documents. It's saved to Knowledge (Investments/Reports) and emailed as an attachment. Read-only in SharePoint and Xero.

# ── Read one investment's SharePoint folder (and its subfolders) and pull the facts out of each document ──
import re

SP = "m365-sharepoint"
# File types the SharePoint connector can read as text.
READABLE = {"docx", "docm", "xlsx", "xlsm", "pptx", "pptm", "pdf", "doc", "xls", "ppt", "rtf", "odt", "ods", "odp",
            "txt", "csv", "tsv", "md", "htm", "html"}
MAX_READ = 50
MAX_DEPTH = 4
MAX_ITEMS = 1500
# Characters of each file sent to AI (the AI step's cap is 32,000 including the prompt).
MAX_TEXT = 12000
# Source-document groups, in the order the report lists them, with the words that identify each
CATEGORIES = [
    ("Tax statements", ["tax"]),
    ("Dividend statements", ["dividend", "distribution", "payment advice"]),
    ("Annual reports", ["annual report", "annual", "financial statement", "financial report", "accounts"]),
    ("Investor updates", ["update", "newsletter", "quarterly", "investor", "shareholder", "report", "presentation"]),
    ("Correspondence", ["correspondence", "letter", "email", "notice", "agreement", "subscription", "minutes",
                        "application", "certificate", "deed"]),
]
DOC_TYPES = {
    "tax statement": "Tax statements",
    "dividend statement": "Dividend statements",
    "annual report": "Annual reports",
    "investor update": "Investor updates",
    "correspondence": "Correspondence",
    "investment agreement": "Correspondence",
}
# Read the documents most likely to hold the investment's terms first, then dividends, then the rest
READ_ORDER = ["Correspondence", "Dividend statements", "Annual reports", "Investor updates", "Tax statements",
              "Other documents"]

PROMPT = (
    "This is one document from a family's records about a single private investment (a company they hold shares "
    "in). Pull out only what this document states; put null or [] when it doesn't say, and never estimate. Money is "
    "a plain number in dollars (no $ or commas). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. "
    "doc_type is one of: tax statement, dividend statement, annual report, investor update, correspondence, "
    "investment agreement, valuation, other. company is the company invested in; holder is the entity that owns "
    "the shares. new_investment is ONLY when this document records money being invested (a subscription, "
    "purchase or capital call): its date and amount. dividends lists ONLY payments this document itself pays or "
    "advises (a dividend statement or payment advice): payment date, cash amount and franked percentage (100 for "
    "fully franked). dividend_year_totals is for documents that total a year's dividends instead (tax "
    "statements): year_ending and amount. valuation is the value this document puts on the whole holding (e.g. a "
    "directors' valuation), with its date and basis in a few words. milestones are up to 3 dated events for the "
    "company or the investment (expansions, new sites, funding rounds, first dividend). business, investment and "
    "rationale are short plain sentences (at most 40 words each): what the company does, what the holding is, "
    "and why it was bought, only if this document says so."
)
SHAPE = (
    '{"doc_type": str, "doc_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null, "company": str|null, "holder": str|null, '
    '"instrument": str|null, "shares": number|null, "price_per_share": number|null, "ownership_pct": number|null, '
    '"new_investment": {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number}|null, '
    '"dividends": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number, "franked_pct": number|null}], '
    '"dividend_year_totals": [{"year_ending": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number}], '
    '"valuation": {"amount": number, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "basis": str}|null, '
    '"milestones": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "text": str}], "website": str|null, "board": str|null, '
    '"status": "active|exited|written off|unknown", "business": str|null, "investment": str|null, '
    '"rationale": str|null}'
)


def _ext(name):
    m = re.search(r"\.([A-Za-z0-9]+)$", str(name or ""))
    return m.group(1).lower() if m else ""


def _err(exc):
    msg = str(exc)
    if msg.startswith("tool_error: "):
        msg = msg[len("tool_error: "):]
    if "no usable credential" in msg or "credential unavailable" in msg:
        return "the SharePoint connection needs connecting (Settings → Connections → m365-sharepoint)"
    return msg[:300]


def _num(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool) or v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return float(v)
    s = re.sub(r"[,$\s]", "", str(v))
    neg = s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")")
    try:
        n = float(s.strip("()"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return -n if neg else n


def _date(v):
    s = str(v or "")[:10]
    return s if re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", s) else ""


def _text(v, limit=400):
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(v or "")).strip()
    return s[:limit] if s and s.lower() not in ("null", "none", "n/a") else ""


def _category(path):
    s = path.lower()
    for name, words in CATEGORIES:
        if any(w in s for w in words):
            return name
    return "Other documents"


def _year(name, modified):
    """The year a file is about: FY24 / 2024 in its name, else the year it was last changed."""
    m = re.search(r"\bFY ?(\d{4}|\d{2})\b", name, re.I)
    if m:
        y = int(m.group(1))
        return {"year": y + 2000 if y < 100 else y, "fy": True}
    m = re.search(r"(?<!\d)((?:19|20)\d{2})(?!\d)", name)
    if m:
        return {"year": int(m.group(1)), "fy": False}
    d = _date(modified)
    return {"year": int(d[:4]) if d else None, "fy": False}


def _list(args):
    out = []
    folder = {}
    cursor = None
    while True:
        page = api.connectors.invoke(server=SP, tool="list_sharepoint_folder",
                                     args={"cursor": cursor} if cursor else dict(args, page_size=200))
        if not isinstance(page, dict):
            raise ValueError("SharePoint sent back something unexpected")
        if not cursor:
            folder = page.get("folder") or {}
        out.extend(page.get("items") or [])
        cursor = page.get("nextCursor")
        if not cursor or len(out) >= MAX_ITEMS:
            return folder, out


def _clean(raw):
    d = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    inv = d.get("new_investment")
    inv = inv if isinstance(inv, dict) else {}
    val = d.get("valuation")
    val = val if isinstance(val, dict) else {}
    out = {
        "doc_type": _text(d.get("doc_type"), 40).lower(),
        "doc_date": _date(d.get("doc_date")),
        "company": _text(d.get("company"), 120),
        "holder": _text(d.get("holder"), 120),
        "instrument": _text(d.get("instrument"), 80),
        "shares": _num(d.get("shares")),
        "price_per_share": _num(d.get("price_per_share")),
        "ownership_pct": _num(d.get("ownership_pct")),
        "new_investment": None,
        "valuation": None,
        "dividends": [],
        "dividend_year_totals": [],
        "milestones": [],
        "website": _text(d.get("website"), 120),
        "board": _text(d.get("board"), 120),
        "status": _text(d.get("status"), 20).lower(),
        "business": _text(d.get("business")),
        "investment": _text(d.get("investment")),
        "rationale": _text(d.get("rationale")),
    }
    amount = _num(inv.get("amount"))
    if _date(inv.get("date")) and amount:
        out["new_investment"] = {"date": _date(inv.get("date")), "amount": abs(amount)}
    amount = _num(val.get("amount"))
    if _date(val.get("date")) and amount:
        out["valuation"] = {"date": _date(val.get("date")), "amount": amount, "basis": _text(val.get("basis"), 80)}
    for x in d.get("dividends") or []:
        amount = _num(x.get("amount")) if isinstance(x, dict) else None
        if isinstance(x, dict) and _date(x.get("date")) and amount:
            out["dividends"].append({"date": _date(x.get("date")), "amount": abs(amount),
                                     "franked_pct": _num(x.get("franked_pct"))})
    for x in d.get("dividend_year_totals") or []:
        amount = _num(x.get("amount")) if isinstance(x, dict) else None
        if isinstance(x, dict) and _date(x.get("year_ending")) and amount is not None:
            out["dividend_year_totals"].append({"year_ending": _date(x.get("year_ending")), "amount": abs(amount)})
    for x in (d.get("milestones") or [])[:3]:
        if isinstance(x, dict) and _date(x.get("date")) and _text(x.get("text")):
            out["milestones"].append({"date": _date(x.get("date")), "text": _text(x.get("text"), 120)})
    return out


link = str(params.get("folder_link") or "").strip()
pick = str(params.get("investment_name") or "").strip().lower()
docs = []
files = []
folder_name = ""
folder_url = ""
problem = ""

if not link:
    problem = "No folder link: paste the investment folder's SharePoint link (Share → Copy link) when you click Run now."
else:
    try:
        top, items = _list({"url": link})
        folder_name = str(top.get("name") or "")
        folder_url = str(top.get("webUrl") or link)
        # A link to the folder of all investments ("Shares") plus an investment name: open that investment's folder
        if pick:
            match = [i for i in items if i.get("isFolder") and pick in str(i.get("name") or "").lower()]
            if match:
                folder_name = str(match[0].get("name") or "")
                folder_url = str(match[0].get("webUrl") or folder_url)
                _, items = _list({"drive_id": match[0].get("driveId"), "item_id": match[0].get("id")})
        queue = [(i, "", 1) for i in items]
        while queue:
            item, parent, depth = queue.pop(0)
            name = str(item.get("name") or "")
            path = (parent + "/" + name) if parent else name
            if item.get("isFolder"):
                if depth < MAX_DEPTH and len(files) < MAX_ITEMS:
                    _, sub = _list({"drive_id": item.get("driveId"), "item_id": item.get("id")})
                    queue.extend((s, path, depth + 1) for s in sub)
                continue
            f = {
                "name": name,
                "path": path,
                "folder": parent,
                "url": str(item.get("webUrl") or ""),
                "id": item.get("id"),
                "driveId": item.get("driveId"),
                "category": _category(path),
                "readable": _ext(name) in READABLE,
            }
            f.update(_year(name, item.get("lastModifiedDateTime")))
            files.append(f)
    except Exception as exc:
        problem = "Couldn't open the folder: " + _err(exc)

    to_read = sorted([f for f in files if f["readable"]],
                     key=lambda f: (READ_ORDER.index(f["category"]), -(f["year"] or 0), f["name"].lower()))
    for f in to_read[:MAX_READ]:
        try:
            r = api.connectors.invoke(server=SP, tool="read_sharepoint_file",
                                      args={"drive_id": f["driveId"], "item_id": f["id"], "max_chars": MAX_TEXT})
        except Exception as exc:
            f["skipped"] = _err(exc)
            continue
        text = str(r.get("text") or "") if isinstance(r, dict) else ""
        if not text.strip():
            f["skipped"] = (str(r.get("note") or "") if isinstance(r, dict) else "") or "no text found"
            continue
        try:
            d = _clean(api.ai.extract(prompt=PROMPT, input="File: " + f["path"] + "\n\n" + text[:MAX_TEXT],
                                      schema_hint=SHAPE))
        except Exception as exc:
            f["skipped"] = "AI couldn't read it (" + str(exc)[:200] + ")"
            continue
        # The AI's view of the document type beats the folder name
        if DOC_TYPES.get(d["doc_type"]):
            f["category"] = DOC_TYPES[d["doc_type"]]
        if d["doc_date"] and not f["fy"]:
            f["year"] = int(d["doc_date"][:4])
        f["read"] = True
        docs.append(dict(d, file=f["name"], url=f["url"], category=f["category"]))
    for f in to_read[MAX_READ:]:
        f["skipped"] = "over the " + str(MAX_READ) + "-file limit for one run (still counted)"
    for f in files:
        f.pop("id", None)
        f.pop("driveId", None)

    if not problem and not docs:
        problem = "No documents could be read in " + (folder_name or "the folder") + "."

summary = (problem + " " if problem else "") + "Found " + str(len(files)) + " file" + \
    ("" if len(files) == 1 else "s") + ", read " + str(len(docs)) + "."

# ── Draw the one-page investment summary PDF, save it to Knowledge and email it ──
import base64
import hashlib
import re
from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from fpdf import FPDF

MAIL = "m365-mail-send"
FOLDER = "Investments/Reports"
DEFAULT_TO = "sean.baker@mysmb.com"
MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
CATEGORY_ORDER = ["Tax statements", "Dividend statements", "Investor updates", "Annual reports", "Correspondence",
                  "Other documents"]

NAVY = (22, 37, 64)
GOLD = (176, 141, 87)
TEAL = (70, 130, 112)
INK = (33, 37, 41)
GREY = (110, 114, 120)
LINE = (222, 220, 214)
PAPER = (244, 242, 237)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)


# -- Formatting --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def d_fmt(iso):
    """dd-Mmm-yy"""
    if not iso:
        return ""
    y, m, d = iso[:10].split("-")
    return d + "-" + MONTHS[int(m) - 1] + "-" + y[2:]


def m_fmt(iso):
    """Mmm yyyy, for milestones"""
    return MONTHS[int(iso[5:7]) - 1] + " " + iso[:4] if iso else ""


def money(n, dp=0):
    return ("-" if n < 0 else "") + "A$" + format(abs(n), ",." + str(dp) + "f")


def short(n):
    """A$250k / A$1.2m"""
    a = abs(n)
    s = ("%.1fm" % (a / 1e6)).replace(".0m", "m") if a >= 1e6 else ("%.1fk" % (a / 1e3)).replace(".0k", "k")
    return ("-" if n < 0 else "") + "A$" + s


def fy(iso):
    return int(iso[:4]) + (1 if int(iso[5:7]) >= 7 else 0)


def held(start, end):
    if not start or not end:
        return ""
    months = (int(end[:4]) - int(start[:4])) * 12 + int(end[5:7]) - int(start[5:7])
    if int(end[8:10]) < int(start[8:10]):
        months -= 1
    y, m = divmod(max(months, 0), 12)
    return (str(y) + " yr" + ("s" if y != 1 else "") + " " if y else "") + str(m) + " mth" + ("s" if m != 1 else "")


def safe(s):
    """Core PDF fonts are Latin-1 only."""
    s = str(s or "")
    for a, b in (("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"), ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("•", "-"),
                 ("…", "..."), ("→", "->"), ("≈", "~"), (" ", " ")):
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    return s.encode("latin-1", "ignore").decode("latin-1")


def npv(rate, pts):
    return sum(a / (1 + rate) ** t for t, a in pts)


def xirr(flows):
    """Annualised return for dated cash flows [(iso, amount)], or None."""
    if len(flows) < 2 or not any(a < 0 for _, a in flows) or not any(a > 0 for _, a in flows):
        return None
    t0 = date.fromisoformat(min(d for d, _ in flows))
    pts = [((date.fromisoformat(d) - t0).days / 365.0, a) for d, a in flows]
    lo, hi = -0.99, 10.0
    if npv(lo, pts) * npv(hi, pts) > 0:
        return None
    for _ in range(200):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        if npv(lo, pts) * npv(mid, pts) <= 0:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    return (lo + hi) / 2


# -- Inputs ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

facts = params.get("facts") or {}
files = params.get("files") or []
xero = params.get("xero") or {}
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
folder_name = str(params.get("folder_name") or "")
folder_url = str(params.get("folder_url") or "")
to = [a.strip() for a in re.split(r"[,;\s]+", str(params.get("email_to") or DEFAULT_TO)) if "@" in a]
brand = str(params.get("family_name") or "").strip()
report_file = ""
emailed_to = ""
sent = ""

if problem or not facts:
    summary = problem or "Nothing to report."
else:
    today = date.today().isoformat()
    company = facts.get("company") or folder_name or "Investment"
    # "Greenfield Cold Chain Pty Ltd" -> "Greenfield Cold Chain" for the heading
    title = re.sub(r"s*((|,)?s*(pty.?s*ltd.?|pty.?s*limited|limited|ltd.?|inc.?))?s*$", "", company, flags=re.I) or company
    holder = facts.get("holder") or ""
    brand = brand or " ".join(holder.split()[:2]) or "Investment summary"
    tranches = facts.get("tranches") or []
    invested = round(sum(t["amount"] for t in tranches), 2)
    start = tranches[0]["date"] if tranches else ""

    dividends = list(facts.get("dividends") or [])
    div_source = "the dividend statements"
    if not dividends and xero.get("receipts"):
        dividends = [{"date": r["date"], "amount": r["amount"], "franked_pct": None} for r in xero["receipts"]]
        div_source = "Xero bank receipts"
    by_fy = {}
    for x in dividends:
        by_fy[fy(x["date"])] = by_fy.get(fy(x["date"]), 0) + x["amount"]
    # Years with only a tax-statement total
    for ye, amt in (facts.get("year_totals") or {}).items():
        by_fy.setdefault(fy(ye), amt)
    div_total = round(sum(by_fy.values()), 2)
    franks = [float(x["franked_pct"]) for x in dividends if x.get("franked_pct") is not None]
    franking = ("fully franked" if franks and all(f >= 99.5 for f in franks) else
                "unfranked" if franks and all(f <= 0.5 for f in franks) else "partly franked" if franks else "")

    val = facts.get("valuation") or {}
    value = val.get("amount")
    report_date = val.get("date") or today
    total_value = (value or 0) + div_total
    moic = total_value / invested if invested and value is not None else None
    flows = [(t["date"], -t["amount"]) for t in tranches] + [(x["date"], x["amount"]) for x in dividends]
    if value is not None and val.get("date"):
        flows.append((val["date"], value))
    irr = xirr(flows) if value is not None and invested else None

    status = (facts.get("status") or "active").upper()
    if status == "UNKNOWN":
        status = "ACTIVE"
    initials = "".join(w[0] for w in brand.split()[:3]).upper() or "INV"
    ref = initials + "-INV-" + today[:4] + "-" + str(int(hashlib.sha256(company.encode()).hexdigest(), 16) % 1000).zfill(3)

    # -- Drawing helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    pdf = FPDF(format="A4", unit="mm")
    pdf.set_auto_page_break(False)
    pdf.set_margins(0, 0, 0)
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.c_margin = 0
    W = 210
    L = 10
    CW = W - 2 * L

    def font(size, style: Any = "", face="Helvetica", color=INK):
        pdf.set_font(face, style, size)
        pdf.set_text_color(*color)

    def box(x, y, w, h, fill=WHITE, border=LINE):
        pdf.set_fill_color(*fill)
        pdf.set_draw_color(*border)
        pdf.set_line_width(0.2)
        pdf.rect(x, y, w, h, style="DF")

    def label(x, y, text, color=GREY, size=6.5):
        font(size, "B", color=color)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0.6)
        pdf.text(x, y, safe(text.upper()))
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0)

    def write(x, y, w, text, size=7.5, lh=3.4, color=INK, style="", max_lines=None, align="L"):
        font(size, style, color=color)
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        lines = pdf.multi_cell(w, lh, safe(text), align=align, dry_run=True, output="LINES")
        if max_lines and len(lines) > max_lines:
            lines = lines[:max_lines]
            lines[-1] = lines[-1].rstrip(" .,;") + "..."
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            pdf.set_xy(x, y + i * lh)
            pdf.cell(w, lh, ln, align=align)
        return y + len(lines) * lh

    def fit(text, w, size, style: Any = ""):
        pdf.set_font(pdf.font_family, style, size)
        t = safe(text)
        if pdf.get_string_width(t) <= w:
            return t
        while t and pdf.get_string_width(t + "...") > w:
            t = t[:-1]
        return t.rstrip() + "..."

    # -- Page --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    pdf.set_fill_color(*PAPER)
    pdf.rect(0, 0, W, 297, style="F")

    # Header band
    pdf.set_fill_color(*NAVY)
    pdf.rect(L, 10, CW, 50, style="F")
    font(13, "B", color=WHITE)
    pdf.set_char_spacing(2.2)
    pdf.text(L + 7, 21, safe(brand.upper()))
    pdf.set_char_spacing(0)
    pdf.set_fill_color(*GOLD)
    pdf.rect(L + 7, 24, 22, 0.7, style="F")
    font(6.5, "", color=(196, 204, 218))
    pdf.set_char_spacing(0.8)
    tag = "INVESTMENT SUMMARY   |   PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL"
    pdf.text(L + CW - 7 - pdf.get_string_width(tag), 20, tag)
    pdf.set_char_spacing(0)
    font(24, "B", "Times", WHITE)
    pdf.text(L + 7, 38, fit(title, CW - 50, 24, "B"))
    font(8.5, "", color=(214, 220, 230))
    sub = " | ".join(s for s in [facts.get("instrument") or "", ("Held by " + holder) if holder else ""] if s)
    pdf.text(L + 7, 45, safe(sub))
    # Status pill
    font(7, "B", color=NAVY)
    sw = pdf.get_string_width(status) + 9
    pdf.set_fill_color(225, 238, 228)
    pdf.rect(L + CW - 7 - sw, 39.5, sw, 5.5, style="F")
    pdf.set_fill_color(46, 125, 80)
    pdf.ellipse(L + CW - 7 - sw + 2.4, 41.5, 1.6, 1.6, style="F")
    pdf.text(L + CW - 7 - sw + 5.2, 43.3, status)
    # Meta line
    x = L + 7
    for k, v in [("Reporting date", d_fmt(report_date)), ("Prepared", d_fmt(today)),
                 ("Holding period", held(start, report_date)), ("Ref", ref)]:
        if not v:
            continue
        font(7, "", color=(170, 180, 198))
        pdf.text(x, 53, k)
        x += pdf.get_string_width(k) + 1.5
        font(7, "B", color=WHITE)
        pdf.text(x, 53, safe(v))
        x += pdf.get_string_width(v) + 6

    # KPI strip
    y = 63
    kw = CW / 5
    count_note = str(len(dividends)) + " payment" + ("s" if len(dividends) != 1 else "") + \
        (", " + franking if franking else "")
    kpis = [
        ("Invested capital", money(invested) if invested else "-", d_fmt(start)),
        ("Carrying value 1", money(value) if value is not None else "-", (val.get("basis") or "")[:34]),
        ("Dividends 2", money(div_total) if div_total else "-", count_note if dividends else ""),
        ("MOIC 3", ("%.2fx" % moic) if moic else "-", ("Total value " + money(total_value)) if moic else ""),
        ("IRR 4", ("%.1f%% p.a." % (irr * 100)) if irr is not None else "-", "Since inception" if irr is not None else ""),
    ]
    box(L, y, CW, 22)
    for i, (k, v, s) in enumerate(kpis):
        x = L + i * kw
        if i:
            pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE)
            pdf.line(x, y + 3, x, y + 19)
        head, _, sup = k.rpartition(" ") if k[-1].isdigit() else (k, "", "")
        label(x + 4, y + 6, head)
        if sup:
            font(6.5, "B")
            lw = pdf.get_string_width(head.upper()) + 0.6 * 25.4 / 72 * len(head)
            font(4.8, "B", color=GREY)
            pdf.text(x + 4 + lw + 0.6, y + 4.8, sup)
        font(14, "B", color=NAVY)
        pdf.text(x + 4, y + 13.5, fit(v, kw - 6, 14, "B"))
        font(6.2, "", color=GREY)
        pdf.text(x + 4, y + 18, fit(s, kw - 6, 6.2))

    # Charts
    y = 89
    hw = (CW - 4) / 2
    box(L, y, hw, 64)
    box(L + hw + 4, y, hw, 64)
    label(L + 4, y + 6, "Value created")
    font(6.2, color=GREY)
    pdf.text(L + 4, y + 9.5, safe("Since inception to " + d_fmt(report_date) + ", A$ thousands"))
    label(L + hw + 8, y + 6, "Dividends by financial year")
    font(6.2, color=GREY)
    pdf.text(L + hw + 8, y + 9.5, safe("A$ thousands, years ending 30 June. Total " + short(div_total)))

    # Waterfall: invested -> change in value -> dividends -> total value
    cx, cy, ch, cwid = L + 6, y + 15, 38, hw - 12
    if invested and value is not None:
        bars = [("Invested", 0, invested, NAVY), ("Change in value", invested, value, TEAL if value >= invested else (190, 80, 70)),
                 ("Dividends", value, value + div_total, GOLD), ("Total value", 0, total_value, NAVY)]
        top = max(max(a, b) for _, a, b, _ in bars) * 1.12
        bw = cwid / len(bars) * 0.55
        base = cy + ch
        pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE)
        pdf.line(cx, base, cx + cwid, base)
        for i, (name, a, b, col) in enumerate(bars):
            bx = cx + (i + 0.5) * cwid / len(bars) - bw / 2
            y1, y2 = base - max(a, b) / top * ch, base - min(a, b) / top * ch
            pdf.set_fill_color(*col)
            pdf.rect(bx, y1, bw, max(y2 - y1, 0.4), style="F")
            delta = b - a if i in (1, 2) else b
            txt = ("+" if i in (1, 2) and delta >= 0 else "") + short(delta)
            font(6.5, "B", color=INK)
            pdf.text(bx + bw / 2 - pdf.get_string_width(txt) / 2, y1 - 1.5, txt)
            font(6, color=GREY)
            pdf.set_xy(bx - 6, base + 1.5)
            pdf.multi_cell(bw + 12, 2.6, name, align="C")
    else:
        write(cx, cy + 15, cwid, "Needs both the amount invested and a current valuation.", color=GREY, align="C")

    # Dividends by FY
    cx = L + hw + 4 + 6
    if by_fy:
        years = list(range(min(by_fy), max(by_fy) + 1))[-12:]
        top = max(by_fy.values()) * 1.18
        slot = cwid / len(years)
        bw = slot * 0.62
        base = cy + ch
        pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE)
        pdf.line(cx, base, cx + cwid, base)
        for i, yr in enumerate(years):
            v = by_fy.get(yr, 0)
            bx = cx + i * slot + (slot - bw) / 2
            h = v / top * ch
            pdf.set_fill_color(*(GOLD if i == len(years) - 1 else NAVY))
            if v:
                pdf.rect(bx, base - h, bw, h, style="F")
            txt = ("%.1f" % (v / 1000)) if v else "-"
            font(5.8, "B", color=INK)
            pdf.text(bx + bw / 2 - pdf.get_string_width(txt) / 2, base - h - 1.3, txt)
            font(5.8, color=GREY)
            lab = "FY" + str(yr)[2:]
            pdf.text(bx + bw / 2 - pdf.get_string_width(lab) / 2, base + 4, lab)
    else:
        write(cx, cy + 15, cwid, "No dividends found in the documents.", color=GREY, align="C")

    # Business overview
    y = 157
    box(L, y, CW, 44)
    label(L + 4, y + 6, "Business overview")
    colw = (CW - 16) / 3
    for i, (head, key) in enumerate([("The business", "business"), ("The investment", "investment"),
                                     ("Investment rationale", "rationale")]):
        x = L + 4 + i * (colw + 4)
        font(11, "B", "Times", NAVY)
        pdf.text(x, y + 14, head)
        write(x, y + 16.5, colw, facts.get(key) or "Not stated in the documents.", size=7.4, lh=3.35, max_lines=9)

    # Key terms / milestones / source documents
    y = 205
    tw = (CW - 8) / 3
    for i in range(3):
        box(L + i * (tw + 4), y, tw, 56)
    # Key terms
    x = L
    label(x + 4, y + 6, "Key terms")
    own = facts.get("ownership_pct")
    shares = facts.get("shares")
    pps = facts.get("price_per_share")
    terms = [
        ("Instrument", facts.get("instrument") or ""),
        ("Shares held", (format(shares, ",.0f") + (" at A$%.2f" % pps if pps else "")) if shares else ""),
        ("Ownership", ("%.1f%%" % own) if own else ""),
        ("Invested", d_fmt(start)),
        ("Board", facts.get("board") or ""),
        ("Website", facts.get("website") or ""),
    ]
    ry = y + 12
    for k, v in terms:
        if not v:
            continue
        font(7, color=GREY)
        pdf.text(x + 4, ry, k)
        font(7, "B", color=INK)
        pdf.text(x + 25, ry, fit(v, tw - 28, 7, "B"))
        pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE)
        pdf.line(x + 4, ry + 2, x + tw - 4, ry + 2)
        ry += 6.5
    # Milestones
    x = L + tw + 4
    label(x + 4, y + 6, "Key milestones")
    ms = facts.get("milestones") or []
    if ms:
        pdf.set_fill_color(*GOLD)
        pdf.rect(x + 5, y + 10, 0.6, min(len(ms), 5) * 8.6 - 2, style="F")
    for j, m in enumerate(ms[:5]):
        my = y + 12.5 + j * 8.6
        font(7, "B", color=NAVY)
        pdf.text(x + 8, my, m_fmt(m["date"]))
        font(6.8, color=INK)
        pdf.text(x + 8, my + 3.4, fit(m["text"], tw - 12, 6.8))
    # Source documents
    x = L + 2 * (tw + 4)
    label(x + 4, y + 6, "Source documents")
    groups = {}
    docs_on_record = [f for f in files if f.get("readable")]
    for f in docs_on_record:
        g = groups.setdefault(f.get("category") or "Other documents", {"n": 0, "years": [], "fy": False, "url": "", "folders": set()})
        g["n"] += 1
        if f.get("year"):
            g["years"].append(f["year"])
        g["fy"] = g["fy"] or bool(f.get("fy"))
        g["folders"].add(f.get("folder") or "")
        g["url"] = g["url"] or f.get("url") or ""
    ry = y + 12
    step = min(7.4, 37.0 / max(len(groups), 1))
    for name in CATEGORY_ORDER:
        g = groups.get(name)
        if not g:
            continue
        yrs = sorted(g["years"])
        span = ""
        if yrs:
            fmt = (lambda v: "FY" + str(v)[2:]) if g["fy"] else str
            span = fmt(yrs[0]) if yrs[0] == yrs[-1] else fmt(yrs[0]) + " to " + fmt(yrs[-1])
        font(7, "B", color=INK)
        pdf.set_xy(x + 4, ry - 2.6)
        pdf.cell(tw - 18, 3.4, name, link=g["url"] or folder_url)
        font(7, "B", color=NAVY)
        n = str(g["n"])
        pdf.text(x + tw - 4 - pdf.get_string_width(n), ry, n)
        font(6, color=GREY)
        pdf.text(x + 4, ry + 3, span)
        pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE)
        pdf.line(x + 4, ry + 4.6, x + tw - 4, ry + 4.6)
        ry += step
    font(7, "B", color=INK)
    pdf.set_xy(x + 4, y + 50)
    pdf.cell(tw - 18, 3.4, "Total on record", link=folder_url)
    tn = str(len(docs_on_record))
    pdf.text(x + tw - 4 - pdf.get_string_width(tn), y + 52.6, tn)

    # Notes and important information
    y = 266
    label(L, y, "Notes")
    notes = [
        "Carrying value is the " + ((val.get("basis") or "valuation") + " at " + d_fmt(val.get("date")) if val else
                                    "latest valuation in the documents") +
        ". It is not a market price and may differ from the amount achievable on sale.",
        "Dividends are the cash amounts in " + div_source + "." + (" " + xero["note"] if xero.get("note") else ""),
        "MOIC is total value (carrying value plus dividends received) divided by invested capital.",
        "IRR is the annualised return on the actual cash flow dates, assuming realisation at carrying value on " +
        (d_fmt(val.get("date")) or "the reporting date") + ". Both exclude franking credits.",
    ]
    ny = y + 2
    for i, n in enumerate(notes):
        ny = write(L, ny, CW / 2 - 4, str(i + 1) + ". " + n, size=5.6, lh=2.5, color=GREY, max_lines=3) + 0.3
    label(L + CW / 2 + 2, y, "Important information")
    write(L + CW / 2 + 2, y + 2, CW / 2 - 2,
          "This summary has been prepared by " + (holder or brand) + " for members of the family group for "
          "information only. It is not financial product advice and does not take into account any person's "
          "objectives, financial situation or needs. Figures are taken from " + str(len(docs_on_record)) + " source documents "
          "with the help of AI and are unaudited unless stated: check them against the documents before relying on "
          "them. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.",
          size=5.6, lh=2.5, color=GREY, max_lines=8)

    # -- Save and send ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    data = bytes(pdf.output())
    clean = re.sub(r'[\\/:*?"<>|]+', " ", company).strip()
    report_file = FOLDER + "/" + clean + " Investment Summary " + d_fmt(today) + ".pdf"
    path = api.files.scratch_path("summary.pdf")
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)
    api.files.put(file=report_file, scratch_file=path)

    if to:
        body = "\n".join([
            "Hi,",
            "",
            "Attached is the one-page investment summary for " + company + ".",
            "",
            "Invested: " + (money(invested) if invested else "not found") + (" (" + d_fmt(start) + ")" if start else ""),
            "Carrying value: " + (money(value) if value is not None else "not found"),
            "Dividends received: " + (money(div_total) + " over " + str(len(dividends)) + " payments" if div_total else "none found"),
            "MOIC: " + ("%.2fx" % moic if moic else "-") + "   IRR: " + ("%.1f%% p.a." % (irr * 100) if irr is not None else "-"),
            xero.get("note") or "",
            "",
            "It was put together from " + str(len(docs_on_record)) + " documents in the SharePoint folder " +
            (folder_name or "") + ". A copy is saved in Knowledge at " + report_file + ".",
            "Figures are taken from the documents with the help of AI. Please check them before sharing.",
        ])
        try:
            api.connectors.invoke(server=MAIL, tool="send_email", args={
                "to": to,
                "subject": "Investment summary: " + company + " (" + d_fmt(today) + ")",
                "body": body,
                "attachments": [{"name": clean + " Investment Summary.pdf", "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(data).decode(),
                                 "contentType": "application/pdf"}],
            })
            emailed_to = ", ".join(to)
            sent = " and emailed it to " + emailed_to
        except Exception as exc:
            msg = str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:200]
            sent = ", but couldn't email it (" + msg + ")"

    summary = "Saved " + report_file + sent + "."

outputs.description: Who the PDF was emailed to.
outputs.name: emailed_to

nodes.summary: Works out invested capital, carrying value, dividends, MOIC and IRR, draws the one-page PDF, saves it to Knowledge as Investments/Reports/<company> Investment Summary <date>.pdf and emails it as an attachment.
nodes.title: Write the PDF and email it

params.name: folder_link

params.description: Optional. When the link is to the folder holding every investment, the subfolder whose name contains this is used.
params.label: Investment name
params.name: investment_name

params.description: Who gets the PDF. Separate several addresses with commas.
params.label: Email to
params.name: email_to

params.description: Shown at the top of the report.
params.label: Name on the report
params.name: family_name

params.description: Optional. Words that identify the dividends in Xero (contact or reference), separated by commas. Leave blank to match the company's name.
params.label: Xero contact or reference to match
